lead: A `.lspt` case whose document holds a construct no other case reached adds a column to the coverage matrix, and `every_request_answers_every_construct` then owes a case for every cursor-taking request at it
body: — one `regions` case over inline HTML cost seven more. The vocabulary is the corpus's own and nothing declares it (`crates/nvs-lsp/src/coverage.rs:56`), so a construct exists the moment one case reaches it. Run `target/debug/nvs.exe lsp-test --coverage tests/lsp/` before `cargo test -p nvs-lsp`: the new column is a row of dots with one number in it.
